      "name": "build",

      "evidence": "Modifies CI setup scripts and GitHub Actions workflow to drop Docker privileged container requirements and dynamic kernel header installation.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.35,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Removes the requirement for Docker privileged mode and dynamic kernel header fetching in the ASan CI task. As noted in the description, 'The ASan CI job no longer needs a privileged container and uses SYS_PTRACE instead,' simplifying CI container configuration and reducing runner maintenance friction."
    },
    {
      "name": "docs",

      "evidence": "doc/tracing.md is updated only to reflect the test framework changes and documentation is not the primary purpose of the PR.",
      "band": "Unranked",

      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Updating tracing documentation follows directly from changing the USDT test runner from BCC to GDB."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Adds a GDB-based USDT test helper in test/functional/test_framework/usdt.py and refactors all USDT functional tests.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.55,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Replaces the complex BCC and eBPF toolchain with GDB to run USDT functional tests in unprivileged environments. According to the PR description, this eliminates host kernel header dependencies and root/BPF privileges while removing 'roughly 660 lines of test and CI code,' removing a substantial barrier to running USDT tests locally."
